main_measure.name: mean of forecast x excess Saturday return over Friday cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of the same Friday summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top fifth minus rest of positive cases, excess Saturday return

decided_by: Inconclusive rule: t >= 2 but the supporting check (top fifth minus rest above 0) failed.
reading: A case is a Friday-start (UTC) bar with forecast > 0 whose next row in the same window is the Saturday bar; the coin's mean daily return is over all next-row returns of all its windows; the day-clustered t sums deviations per Friday with a D/(D-1) correction; the top fifth per coin is the ceil(20%) highest forecasts (stable order on ties); fewer than the plan's minimum counts gives 'not observable'.
